channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam’s Hoodi test over contract risks
item.description: Ethereum postponed Glamsterdam on Hoodi after developers cited EIP-8037 contract risks; the Oct. 26 test and 200M gas-limit increase are off pending review.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its voting system and targeting 150ms finality; users keep their wallets, while actual speeds may vary.

item.title: Uniswap adds external liquidity to v4 on three chains
item.description: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, routing swaps through outside liquidity while fees from those trades contribute to UNI burns.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow with 150ms finality target
item.description: Solana activated Anza’s Alpenglow consensus upgrade on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system targeting 150ms finality; live performance can vary.

item.title: HSBC launches HKD stablecoin RedCoin on PayMe
item.description: HSBC launched its first HKD stablecoin on PayMe, with wallet access rolling out to 3.3 million users and payments at more than 100,000 merchants.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a protocol targeting 150-millisecond finality; its planned data relay upgrade has no release date.

item.title: ZeroFi deposit minimum: what 0.01 XMR means for costs
item.description: ZeroFi’s 0.01 XMR deposit floor sets the smallest transfer, not its fee; fixed charges, network costs and later Ethereum gas affect the cost per deposit.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto platforms free to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC says stablecoin issuers cannot pay holders interest, but crypto platforms can offer rewards tied to stablecoin earnings from Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: Partial Fills Let Large Token Orders Execute in Pieces
item.description: Partial fills let large token orders execute in eligible pieces across auctions, but they do not guarantee completion or reduce price impact without a workable limit.

item.title: Mantle forced inclusion adds an Ethereum fee to withdrawals
item.description: Mantle’s forced-inclusion route can preserve an exit when sequencing fails, but it adds an Ethereum transaction fee alongside the usual withdrawal and claim costs.

item.title: Crypto bridge fees vary by token and direction
item.description: Bridge fees vary by token and direction. See which currency pays gas, when a service fee applies and how to compare the net amount before you confirm.

item.title: Arbswap on Arbitrum: Swaps, Liquidity and Costs
item.description: Arbswap lets traders swap tokens and supply liquidity on Arbitrum One and Nova; costs depend on pool fees, price impact and network gas at execution.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin exchange rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield but leaves exchange rewards subject to case-by-case review, with the framework starting in 2027.

item.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail bitcoin ETF
item.description: FINMA approved Switzerland’s first retail fund holding bitcoin directly, creating a regulated route for public investors as other providers seek approval.

item.title: thor swap routes: when to use each path
item.description: THORSwap routes trades through cross-chain protocols, on-chain DEX liquidity or split swaps; the right path depends on the assets, quoted output and urgency.

item.title: Repay a Crypto Loan by Converting Into Its Borrowed Token
item.description: Loan interest usually adds to the debt in the borrowed token. Convert another asset into that token, check the updated balance and network, then repay.

item.title: Mayan Bridge turns cross-chain transfers into one transaction
item.description: Mayan lets teams send one token and receive another across chains; solver auctions, route quotes and settlement checks shape the cost and delivery terms.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
item.description: JPMorgan has deployed its USD deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, adding a second public network for around-the-clock transfers.

item.title: Bitcoin miner revenue rebounds 78% to $48 million a day
item.description: Bitcoin mining revenue climbed from about $27 million in July to $48 million as BTC recovered, easing pressure while rising difficulty threatens the rebound.

item.title: Ledger unveils $899 Atom device after wallet thefts
item.description: Ledger unveiled its Atom Android security device on Oct. 15, with $899 orders planned after launch and shipments estimated for Q2 2027, amid a wallet tampering probe.
